mapper.select: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE hot_keyword SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE is_manual = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hot_keyword (keyword, search_count, is_manual, is_pinned, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{searchCount}, 0, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = VALUES(search_count), status = 1, update_time = NOW()
